name: Engineering contract management and immutable electronic-signing evidence
requiresDatabases: engineering tenant existing contracts data source
engineering tenant existing projects data source
engineering tenant existing group bindings data source

dataIsolation.guard: The package is engineering-only. PostgreSQL evidence rows use tenant_key=engineering, Drive files remain below the engineering tenant root, and Notion is a retryable projection rather than signing authority. No Rental, HOZO, Seven, Forest, or Green Hotel records, IDs, tokens, or files may be copied into this schema.

definitionOfDone: The engineering contract backend uses the engineering_contracts PostgreSQL schema as the authoritative workflow and evidence store
Every issued version contains a hashed contract body, at least one construction drawing, at least one quotation, payment terms, and acceptance criteria
Exactly one designated external signer is bound to a seven-day opaque token, a LIFF identity, an active source group membership, and the configured LINE user ID
The signing invitation is accepted by the LINE Messaging API for the contract's bound group and the accepted request is recorded as evidence
Issued versions, signatures, signed artifacts, and signing events cannot be updated or deleted through the application role
The signed PDF and evidence receipt contain the signature, IP address, issued time, LINE send-accepted time, authenticated received time, and signed time
Notion receives only a retryable contract projection and cannot independently mark a contract signed
The final PDF, signature image, source documents, and evidence receipt are stored below the engineering Drive root with SHA-256 hashes
Local schema, JSON, authorization, token-expiry, idempotency, and package checks pass before production enablement
The feature remains disabled until a controlled engineering pilot is accepted
